name: flowbook
description: flowbook — a framework for flexible data flows.

scripts.db:fresh: docker compose -f infra/compose.postgres.yml --env-file infra/.env.postgres down -v && docker compose -f infra/compose.postgres.yml --env-file infra/.env.postgres up -d
scripts.test:ci: FLOWBOOK_DATABASE_URL= uv run pytest -q -m "not integration and not e2e"
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:ci
scripts.ci:fix: npm run fmt && npm run lint:fix && npm run typecheck && npm run test:ci
